# CodeyLabs

> CodeyLabs builds 100% Salesforce-native AppExchange applications and provides custom Salesforce architecture and ISV development services. All products run natively on the Salesforce platform with zero external servers, connected apps, or third-party data storage.

## Core Products (AppExchange Managed Packages)

- [QuoteX (Pre Sales Cloud)](https://www.codeylabs.com/): Salesforce-native services scoping, estimation, and quoting solution designed to streamline fixed-fee deals and protect delivery margins. Includes scope libraries, resource planning, and Agentforce/MCP AI-assisted quoting.
- [DRTE (Dynamic Rich Text Editor & Document Engine)](https://www.codeylabs.com/): 100% Salesforce-native document generation and e-signature solution with full audit trails, conditional templating, multi-language support, and native exports (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) without external integrations or Word dependencies.
- [Build Your Own Branding (BYOB Suite)](https://www.codeylabs.com/): UI customization and branding toolkit for Salesforce Lightning and Experience Cloud, including List View Row Highlights and Field Label Overrider.
- [Feedback 360 (F360)](https://www.codeylabs.com/): Native Salesforce survey, conditional question routing, and timed internal mock-test assessment engine.

## Documentation & Support

- [CodeyLabs Knowledge Hub](https://help.codeylabs.com/): Complete administrator guides, setup tutorials, release notes, and architectural documentation for QuoteX, DRTE, BYOB, and F360.
- [Contact & Custom Services](https://www.codeylabs.com/): Custom AppExchange managed package development (1GP/2GP), security review preparation, and Salesforce consulting.

## Architecture & Security Principles

- **100% Native Architecture:** Built exclusively using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and Salesforce Flows.
- **Data Residency & Security:** Customer data never leaves the subscriber's Salesforce org. No external middleware, third-party APIs, or off-platform databases.
